info.title: Smart Tracking API
info.description: API for managing carrier status mappings and file processing

post.summary: Upload a new carrier tracking data file
post.description:
Uploads a carrier tracking data file (CSV or XLSX format) for processing.

Sample request:

    POST /api/files
    Content-Type: multipart/form-data

    file: [binary file data]
    carrier_name: "DHL Express"
    description_column_index: 0
    description_column_name: "Status Description"

**File Requirements:**
- Maximum file size: 10MB
- Supported formats: .csv, .xlsx
- Must contain carrier status descriptions

**Description Column:**
Specify either `description_column_index` (zero-based) or `description_column_name` to identify the column containing status descriptions.

file.description: The file to upload (CSV or XLSX format, max 10MB)

carrier_name.description: Name of the carrier this file belongs to

description_column_index.description: Zero-based index of the column containing status descriptions (optional, use either this or DescriptionColumnName)

description_column_name.description: Name of the column containing status descriptions (optional, use either this or DescriptionColumnIndex)

201.description: File uploaded successfully. Returns the file ID for tracking.

400.description: Invalid request. Model validation failed or missing required fields.

422.description: Unsupported file format. Only CSV and XLSX files are accepted.

get.summary: Retrieve a paginated list of uploaded files
get.description:
Gets a list of all uploaded carrier tracking files with pagination support.

Sample request:

    GET /api/files?page=1&page_size=10

**Pagination:**
- Default page size: 20
- Maximum page size: 100
- Pages are 1-indexed

parameters.name: carrier_name
parameters.description: Filter by carrier name (optional, case-insensitive partial match)

parameters.name: statuses
parameters.description: Filter by file statuses (optional, returns files matching any of the specified statuses)

items.description:
Status of an uploaded file in the processing pipeline

**Possible values:**

* `new`
* `pending` - File waiting for processing
* `processing` - File is currently being processed
* `completed` - File processing completed successfully
* `failed` - File processing failed due to an error
* `approved` - File approved for further processing
* `rejected` - File rejected and will not be processed
* `archived` - File archived (hidden from default views)

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of items per page (1-100, default: 20)

parameters.name: ascending
parameters.description: Sort order for results (default: true for ascending)

400.description: Invalid pagination parameters (page must be greater than 0, pageSize must be between 1 and 100)

patch.summary: Update file status (approve, reject, or archive)
patch.description:
Updates the status of an uploaded file. Available status transitions:
- **Approved**: Mark file as approved for processing
- **Rejected**: Mark file as rejected (will not be processed)
- **Archived**: Archive the file (removes from default listing)

Sample request:

    PATCH /api/files
    Content-Type: application/json

    {
      "id": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6",
      "status": "approved"
    }

requestBody.description: Update request containing file ID and new status

400.description: Invalid request or invalid status value

delete.description:
Permanently deletes a file and all associated records and mappings.

Sample request:

    DELETE /api/files/3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6

**Warning:** This action cannot be undone. All data associated with the file will be permanently removed.

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the file to delete

get.summary: Export file records to Excel format
get.description:
Exports all records from a specific file to an Excel (.xlsx) file for download.

Sample request:

    GET /api/files/3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6

**Output Format:**
- File type: Excel (.xlsx)
- Columns: Record ID, Original Line, Status Description, Status Code, Approval Status, Updated By, Updated On
- File name format: `{carrier_name}_file_{file_id}_{date}.xlsx`

**Use Cases:**
- Export processed records for review
- Share mapping results with stakeholders
- Archive processed data

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the file to export

403.description: Forbidden. User does not have export permissions.

500.description: Internal server error during file generation

400.description: Bad request. All mappings failed or validation error.

get.summary: Retrieve status mappings with optional filtering and pagination
get.description:
Gets a list of status mappings with support for filtering by carrier and status description.

Sample request:

    GET /api/mappings?carrier=DHL%20Express&page=1&page_size=50&ascending=true

**Filtering:**
- `carrier`: Filter by carrier name (case-insensitive partial match)
- `status_description`: Filter by status description (case-insensitive partial match)

**Pagination:**
- Default page size: 50
- Maximum page size: 1000
- If `page` is not specified, all results are returned

**Sorting:**
- `ascending=true`: Sort A-Z by status description
- `ascending=false`: Sort Z-A by status description

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of items per page (1-100, default: 20)

parameters.name: ascending
parameters.description: Sort order for results (default: true for ascending)

400.description: Invalid parameters (e.g., pageSize out of range)

patch.description:
Updates multiple status mappings in a single request. Allows modifying status descriptions and CDM status codes.

Sample request:

    PATCH /api/mappings
    Content-Type: application/json

    [
      {
        "id": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6",
        "status_description": "Delivered Successfully",
        "status_code": "delivered"
      },
      {
        "id": "8b2c5e1a-9d3f-4a7e-b8c6-1f2e3d4a5b6c",
        "status_description": "Out for Delivery",
        "status_code": "out_for_delivery"
      }
    ]

**Response Codes:**
- **200**: All updates successful
- **207**: Partial success (some updates succeeded, some failed)
- **400**: Bad request or validation error
- **404**: One or more mappings not found
- **422**: Unprocessable entity (e.g., duplicate mapping)

requestBody.description: Array of mapping updates, each containing ID and new values

207.description: Partial success. Some mappings updated, some failed. Check individual results.

404.description: One or more mappings not found

422.description: Unprocessable entity (e.g., duplicate mapping would be created)

delete.summary: Batch delete status mappings by IDs
delete.description:
Deletes multiple status mappings in a single request by their IDs.

Sample request:

    DELETE /api/mappings?mapping_ids=3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6,8b2c5e1a-9d3f-4a7e-b8c6-1f2e3d4a5b6c

**Response Codes:**
- **200**: All deletions successful
- **207**: Partial success (some deletions succeeded, some failed)
- **400**: Bad request (e.g., empty ID list)

207.description: Partial success. Some mappings deleted, some failed. Check individual results.

get.summary: Export carrier mappings to Excel file
get.description:
Exports all status mappings for a specific carrier to an Excel (.xlsx) file.

Sample request:

    GET /api/mappings/export?carrier=DHL%20Express

**Output Format:**
- File type: Excel (.xlsx)
- Columns: Status Description, CDM Status Code
- File name format: `{carrier_name}_mappings_{date}.xlsx`

**Use Cases:**
- Backup of current mappings
- Review and audit of mapping configurations
- Sharing mapping configurations with stakeholders

parameters.description: Carrier name to export mappings for (required)

get.summary: Get all records for a specific file
get.description:
Retrieves all tracking status records from a specific uploaded file with pagination support.

Sample request:

    GET /api/files/3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6/records?page=1&page_size=50

**Record Information:**
Each record contains:
- Original line from the file
- Extracted status description
- AI-suggested status code (if available)
- Manually assigned status code (if mapped)
- Approval status
- Audit information (updated by, updated on)

**Pagination:**
- Default page size: 50
- Maximum page size: 100
- Pages are 1-indexed

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the file

400.description: Invalid parameters (e.g., page < 1, pageSize out of range)

put.description:
Updates multiple records in a file by approving or rejecting their status code mappings.

Sample request:

    PUT /api/files/3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6/records
    Content-Type: application/json

    [
      {
        "id": "7b2c5e1a-9d3f-4a7e-b8c6-1f2e3d4a5b6c",
        "status_code": "delivered",
        "is_approved": true
      },
      {
        "id": "9e3f6d2a-1c4e-5b8f-a7d9-2e3f4a5b6c7d",
        "status_code": "in_transit",
        "is_approved": false
      }
    ]

**Update Options:**
- Set `is_approved: true` to approve the current or specified status code
- Set `is_approved: false` to reject the status code (requires manual review)
- Optionally specify `status_code` to override the suggested mapping

**Response Codes:**
- **200**: All records updated successfully
- **207**: Partial success (some updates succeeded, some failed)
- **400**: Bad request or validation error

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the file containing the records

requestBody.description: Array of record updates, each containing record ID and approval status

207.description: Partial success. Some records updated, some failed. Check individual results.

404.description: File or one or more records not found

get.summary: Get all available CDM status codes
get.description:
Retrieves a sorted list of all supported CDM status codes that can be used for mapping carrier statuses.

Sample request:

    GET /api/statuses

**Common Status Codes:**
- delivered
- in_transit
- out_for_delivery
- failed_attempt
- exception
- available_for_pickup
- and more...

Status codes are returned in lowercase and alphabetically sorted.

get.summary: Get AI-powered status code suggestions for a given status description
get.description:
Analyzes a carrier-specific status description and returns suggested CDM status codes with confidence scores.
            
Sample request:
            
    GET /api/status-suggestions?status_description=Package%20delivered%20to%20recipient
            
**Response:**
Returns an array of suggested status codes ordered by confidence (highest first).
Each suggestion includes:
- **status_code**: The standardized CDM status code
- **confidence**: Prediction confidence score (0.0 to 1.0)
            
**Confidence Score Interpretation:**
- **0.9 - 1.0**: Very high confidence (usually accurate)
- **0.7 - 0.9**: High confidence (generally reliable)
- **0.5 - 0.7**: Medium confidence (review recommended)
- **Below 0.5**: Low confidence (manual review required)
            
**Use Cases:**
- Assist users in mapping new carrier statuses
- Automate bulk status mapping with high-confidence predictions
- Validate existing mappings

parameters.name: status_description
parameters.description: The carrier-specific status description to analyze (required, max 500 characters)

200.description: Successfully generated suggestions. Returns array of status codes with confidence scores.

400.description: Bad request. Status description is missing or empty.

422.description: Unprocessable entity. Status description is too long or contains invalid characters.

503.description: ML service unavailable. The prediction service is currently unavailable.

status_code.description:
Standardized CDM (Common Data Model) status codes for shipment tracking

**Possible values:**

* `carrier_status_not_mapped` - Status not mapped. Please check the carrier's website for updates.
* `closed_by_system` - Tracking for this parcel has expired. If you're still expecting this delivery, please contact the carrier for
                assistance.
* `unspecified_exception` - The carrier has reported an issue with your parcel, but details are unavailable.
* `collection_failed` - Parcel pickup failed. The delivery company will try again soon.
* `collection_made` - Your parcel has been picked up by the carrier.
* `collection_requested` - Your parcel is waiting to be handed over to the carrier.
* `dropped_off` - Your parcel has been dropped off and is ready for carrier processing.
* `elec_advice_recd_by_carrier` - Your shipment is now in the carrier's system.
* `not_yet_received_by_carrier` - The carrier has not yet received your parcel, which may cause a delay.
* `attempted_delivery` - The carrier attempted to deliver your parcel but was unable to complete delivery.
* `attempted_delivery_final` - The carrier made a final attempt to deliver your parcel but was unable to complete delivery. Please check the
                carrier's instructions for next steps.
* `cod_amount_not_paid` - Delivery failed due to unpaid cash on delivery. Please follow carrier instructions.
* `cod_amount_paid` - Cash on delivery payment received.
* `customer_carded` - Delivery attempt failed. Please follow delivery instructions left by the carrier.
* `customer_identification_failed` - Delivery couldn't be completed as identification requirements were not met.
* `customer_to_collect_from_carrier` - Your parcel is available for collection from the carrier's local delivery unit.
* `delivery_scheduled` - Your parcel's delivery has been scheduled and will soon be out for delivery.
* `no_access_to_recipients_address` - The carrier couldn't access the delivery location due to restricted entry.
* `out_for_delivery` - Your parcel is on its way and will be delivered today.
* `cancelled` - Your parcel has been cancelled.
* `customer_moved` - Delivery failed as the recipient is no longer at the specified address. Your parcel is being returned.
* `hazardous_prohibited` - Your parcel contains restricted items and will not be delivered.
* `not_collected_from_pickup_point` - Your parcel was not collected from the pickup point within the designated time and will be returned.
* `not_delivered` - All delivery attempts failed. Your parcel is being returned to the sender.
* `not_delivered_addressee_deceased` - The parcel could not be delivered as the addressee is reported deceased.
* `parcel_disposed` - Your parcel has been disposed of due to its contents or condition and will not be delivered.
* `parcel_lost` - The carrier has reported that your parcel is lost and will not be delivered.
* `parcel_outside_of_service_capability` - The parcel cannot be delivered as it exceeds the carrier's service limits.
* `refused_by_customer` - You have refused the parcel, and it will be returned to the sender.
* `return_to_sender` - Your parcel is being returned to the sender due to delivery issues.
* `undeliverable_returned_to_sender` - The shipment has been returned to the sender. Please contact the sender for further information.
* `address_query` - There is an issue with the delivery address, which may delay your parcel.
* `carrier_delays` - Your parcel is delayed due to issues within the carrier network.
* `customs_cleared` - Your parcel has cleared customs and is continuing its journey.
* `customs_processing` - Your parcel is currently being processed by customs.
* `delayed_not_carrier` - Your parcel is delayed due to circumstances beyond the carrier's control.
* `delivery_arranged_with_recipient` - Your parcel's delivery has been arranged with the carrier.
* `delivery_rescheduled` - Your parcel's delivery has been rescheduled due to operational issues.
* `duty_not_paid` - The import taxes or duties for this package haven't been paid and it may be subject to disposal by customs
                authorities if payment is not made.
* `held_by_carrier` - Your parcel is being held due to an operational issue. Contact with the carrier for more information.
* `held_by_carrier_for_clearance_pre_processing` - Your parcel is being held by the carrier for customs documentation checks. This may occur when the carrier must
                confirm documentation before the parcel can continue its journey.
* `held_by_customs` - Your parcel is being held at customs, which may delay delivery.
* `hub_processing` - Your parcel is being processed at a carrier hub.
* `hub_scan_in` - Your parcel has arrived at the carrier's hub for processing.
* `hub_scan_out` - Your parcel has left the carrier's hub.
* `in_transit` - Your shipment is on its way between the carrier hubs.
* `incorrect_declaration` - Your parcel has been incorrectly declared but is still moving forward for delivery.
* `information` - The carrier has shared additional information about your parcel.
* `parcel_damaged` - Your parcel was damaged in transit but will still be delivered.
* `parcel_over_labelled` - Your parcel's label has been updated by the carrier, which may affect tracking visibility.
* `parcel_redirected_by_carrier` - The carrier has redirected your parcel due to an operational issue. The package is likely being rerouted to a
                nearby pickup point. You may contact the carrier for more details about the new delivery location.
* `parcel_redirected_by_recipient` - Your parcel has been redirected to a new delivery address per your request.
* `parcel_repacked` - Your parcel was repackaged by the carrier due to damage and will still be delivered.
* `parcel_update_notification` - The carrier has sent you an update on your parcel status via SMS or email.
* `recd_by_carrier_no_elec_advice` - Your parcel has been received by the carrier but may experience delays due to missing pre-advice.
* `received_by_carrier` - Your parcel has been received by the carrier and is beginning its journey.
* `received_local_delivery_depot` - Your parcel has arrived at the local delivery depot and is almost ready for delivery.
* `routing_error` - Your parcel was sent to the wrong place due to a routing error but is being redirected.
* `sub_contractor_event` - The carrier has shared additional information about your parcel's handling by a delivery partner.
* `sub_contractor_received` - Your parcel has been received by the carrier's local delivery partner.
* `awaiting_collection_from_pickup_point` - Your parcel is ready for collection at the selected pickup point.
* `collect_at_local_po` - Your parcel is ready for collection at your local post office.
* `delivered` - Your parcel has been successfully delivered.
* `delivered_damaged` - Your parcel was delivered but arrived with visible damage.
* `delivered_in_part` - Part of your shipment has been delivered. Check for updates on the rest.
* `delivered_specified_safe_place` - Your parcel has been delivered to your specified safe place.
* `delivered_to_alternative_delivery_location` - Your parcel was delivered to an alternative location due to the delivery company being unable to deliver it to the
                specified address. Check carrier instructions for pickup details.
* `delivered_to_locker_collection_point` - Your package has been delivered to the pickup point. You'll be notified when it's ready for collection.
* `delivered_to_neighbour` - Your parcel was delivered to your neighbor.
* `delivered_to_po_box` - Your parcel has been delivered to your specified PO Box.
* `delivered_to_reception` - Your parcel has been delivered to your building's reception or designated mail area.
* `parcel_collected_from_pickup_point` - Your package has been picked up from the pick up point.
* `post_transit_status` - The carrier has added more information about your delivery.
* `proof_of_delivery` - The carrier has confirmed delivery with proof, such as a signature or photo.
* `collected_from_pick_up_point` - Your package has been collected from the pickup point.
* `damaged` - Your parcel was damaged during transit.
* `delayed` - Your parcel has been delayed.
* `delivered_to_different_address` - Your parcel was delivered to a different address than originally specified.
* `delivered_to_pickup_point` - Your parcel has been delivered to a pickup point.
* `held` - Your parcel is being held.
* `lost` - Your parcel has been reported as lost.
* `misroute` - Your parcel was misrouted during transit.
* `partial_delivery` - Only part of your shipment has been delivered.
* `received_in_depot` - Your parcel has been received at the depot.
* `refused_by_recipient` - The recipient has refused to accept the parcel.
